# Water Mask Small

A tiny single-band uint8 binary water mask (0 = land, 1 = water) with a sentinel NoData value of 255. Exercises mask-style raster handling and nodata-aware logic.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `water_mask_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("water_mask_small")
def test_water_mask_small(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase can open a binary water mask, preserve its single uint8 band, and honour the sentinel NoData value during masking logic.

## Risk types covered

- [`dtype_drift`](../../risk/dtype-drift.md)
- [`mask_misread`](../../risk/mask-misread.md)
- [`nodata_ignored`](../../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
